Digitised from the vector content of Fig. 2 (page 16 of the report PDF): the time axis is calibrated on its 29 tick marks (every 25 h, 0 to 700 h), the value axis on its 7 gridlines (0 to 6 particle equivalents, 32.40 pt apart, no residual); least-squares time calibration, largest tick residual 0.25 h. Reading uncertainty +/-0.01 particle equivalents (the stored positions have a granularity of 0.12 pt = 0.004 equivalents, and the markers sit 0.004 above the axis at the zero line) and +/-0.3 h in time (tick granularity 0.24 pt = 0.5 h, so +/-0.25 h, plus the marker granularity).
